{{Character Infobox |color={{blue color}} |corecolor={{blue color light}} |bordercolor={{blue color dark}} |name=Gorm |jname=アスラ |tmname=Azula |jtranslit=Asura |text=fff |caption=Gorm in [[Pokémon Adventures]] |image=Gorm Adventures.png |size=185px |gender=Male |eyes=Gray |hair=Gray |region=[[Unova]] }} {{Character Infobox/Game |color={{blue color light}} |gen={{gen|V}} |games={{game3|Black and White|Black, White|s}}, {{B2W2|Black 2, White 2}} }} {{Character Infobox/Team |color={{blue color light}} |member=[[Team Plasma]] |rank=[[Seven Sages|Sage]] }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{blue color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Generations]]'' |debut=''[[PG13|The Uprising]]'' |enva=Unknown |jpva=Ryōma Abe }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{blue color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' |debut=''[[PS467|Letting Go]]'' }} |} '''Gorm''' (Japanese: '''アスラ''' ''Azula'') is one of the [[Seven Sages]] of [[Team Plasma]]. ==In the core series games== In {{game|Black and White|s}}, Gorm is first met in [[Pinwheel Forest]]. He appears right after the {{player}} has defeated the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s and says that the [[Dragon Skull]] is not important to Team Plasma's goals. Later, he is seen along with the other sages confronting the [[Gym Leader]]s of the [[Unova]] [[region]] at [[N's Castle]]. After Ghetsis has been defeated, Gorm can be found in the [[Dreamyard]], where he gives the player {{TM|75|Swords Dance}} and is arrested by [[Looker]]. In {{B2W2}}, Gorm appears in Pinwheel Forest while the player and [[Cheren]] are investigating there. He tries to sneak up on them much like he did to {{ga|Hilbert}}/{{ga|Hilda}} in Black and White in the Dreamyard. He speaks to the two briefly and leaves. He is then pursued by Cheren. ===Quotes=== ====Pokémon Black and White==== '''[[Pinwheel Forest]]''' :''"How are you holding up, fellow subject of our king?"'' :''"It's not important. We can afford to abandon the Dragon Skull. According to the results of our research, this is not the [[legendary Pokémon]] for which Team Plasma is looking. It is completely unrelated. But we will not allow anyone to disrupt our plans and get away with it. We will fix it so you never interfere with us again."'' :''"I am one of the Seven Sages of Team Plasma. [[Ghetsis]], another of the Seven Sages, will liberate Pokémon with words alone! The remainder of the Seven Sages have ordered their compatriots to take Pokémon with full force! But the odds are a little against us now. To you, the {{t|Bug}} Pokémon user [[Burgh]] and the {{t|Normal}} Pokémon user [[Lenora]], I say... Know your enemies, know yourself, and know you need not fear the result of a hundred battles... This time, we shall retreat quietly. To secure the liberation of Pokémon we will steal from Trainers! Even though you are [[Gym Leader]]s, we will not tolerate any further obstruction from you. In any case, we will settle this someday. I hope you are looking forward to that time as much as I..."'' '''[[N's Castle]]''' :''"If you make a mistake and do not correct it, that is a second mistake."'' :''"A single fallen leaf signals the start of autumn. We know our history. The emergence of this castle is the harbinger of change in Unova..."'' '''[[Dreamyard]]''' :''"Boo!"'' :''"Were you surprised? Oh, {{pkmn|Trainer}}-who-destroyed-our-castle, I was quite surprised by you!"'' :''"If you surprise them, both Pokémon and people leave themselves open. While they're in a state of surprise, they can't use their powers like they normally would. Our intention was to surprise people by making our castle appear and showing off the legendary Pokémon... At that moment, we planned to deeply impress people's hearts with the awesome power of Team Plasma and the brilliance of our new world."'' :''"Now that I've seen the strength of spirit in you and the [[Gym Leader]]s, I wonder how effective that strategy would have been, after all. Its [[Dream Mist]] makes you see dreams, but they are nothing but illusions. The dreams you realize with your own abilities are the real dreams."'' ====Pokémon Black 2 and White 2==== '''[[Pinwheel Forest]]''' :''"Boo!"'' :''"I am Gorm. {{color2|fff|Generation V}} |} ==In animation== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Gorm PG.png|thumb|250px|Gorm in [[Pokémon Generations]]]] ===Pokémon Generations=== Gorm appeared in ''[[PG13|The Uprising]]''. He was shown at [[N's Castle]] as it was rising from the ground and surrounding the {{un|Pokémon League}}. ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{blue color}}|bordercolor={{blue color dark}} |ja=安部亮馬 ''Ryōma Abe'' |en=Unknown |es_eu=Mario Fernández}} ==In the manga== [[File:Rood Gorm Bronius Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Gorm in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Black & White}}==== Gorm is one of the Seven Sages of Team Plasma. Three years prior to the start of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}, he was tasked with finding information on {{adv|Tao trio|Reshiram and Zekrom}} so they could potentially be recruited to Team Plasma's side. Gorm debuted in person in ''[[PS467|Letting Go]]'', where he and the other sages were seen in [[Accumula Town]] after [[Ghetsis]] gave a speech convincing people to release their Pokémon. In ''[[PS475|The Mystery of the Missing Fossil]]'', Gorm worked with three {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s and stole a [[Dragon Skull|Dragon-type fossil]] from the {{DL|Nacrene City|Nacrene Museum}}. {{adv|Black}} tracked down the thieves to [[Pinwheel Forest]], where he was attacked by the fossil. Using his deductive skills, Black figured out that Gorm's {{p|Cofagrigus}} was manipulating the skeleton and defeated it with the help of [[Burgh]]'s {{p|Whirlipede}}. Before escaping, Gorm revealed Team Plasma aimed to have a {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon fight by their side. In ''[[PS520|Cold Hard Truth]]'', Team Plasma launched their attack on the {{un|Pokémon League}}, surrounding the building with N's Castle. As a form of mockery and display of Team Plasma's power, the [[Gym Leader]]s were hoisted on cross-like fixtures and displayed in front of the masses. While Black went ahead to face {{adv|N}}, a group of regular Trainers led by {{tc|Hiker}} Andy fought the sages in his place. Together, Andy and the others managed to free the Gym Leaders, forcing Gorm and the other sages to flee. ===={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}==== Two years later, Gorm and the other sages were sought after by the [[International Police]] members {{adv|Blake}} and {{adv|Looker}}, who aimed to arrest them along with the other remaining Team Plasma members. Unlike the other sages, Gorm, along with Rood, decided to side with the members of Team Plasma who believed in N's ideals. In ''[[PS545|Deduction Time]]'', Gorm, [[Iris]], and [[Alder]] worked together to break out of the [[White Treehollow]], which had been frozen solid by the [[Plasma Frigate]]. As they traveled, Gorm and Iris encountered Black, {{adv|White}}, {{adv|Blake}}, and {{adv|Whitley}}. After clarifying that he was on the side of good, Black and the others agreed to trust him. The group was then attacked by [[Colress]] and {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}}. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Gorm |pkmn=Cofagrigus |gender=male |type1=Ghost |img=Gorm Cofagrigus Adventures.png |epnum=PS475 |epname=The Mystery of the Missing Fossil |desc={{p|Cofagrigus}} is Gorm's first known Pokémon. It was used by Gorm to take control of and animate the Dragonite Fossil. Gorm had Cofagrigus hide himself among the other artifacts so anyone who would try to stop them would be confused as to what was controlling the Fossil. However, their plan was foiled by Black and Burgh, and Cofagrigus was found out. When Gorm told Cofagrigus to retreat, Burgh stopped him with his Whirlipede. Cofagrigus's only known move is {{m|Guard Split}}{{tt|*|mentioned and used off-panel}} and his Ability is {{a|Mummy}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Gorm |pkmn=Sigilyph |type1=Psychic |type2=Flying |img=Gorm Sigilyph Benga Tepig Adventures.png |epnum=PS546 |epname=Giant Chasm |desc={{p|Sigilyph}} is Gorm's second known Pokémon. It was first seen being used to train at White Treehollow, where it battled [[Benga]]'s {{p|Larvesta}} and {{p|Tepig}}. Sigilyph's only known move is {{m|Stored Power}}{{tt|*|mentioned and used off-panel}}.}} In ''[[PS521|Triple Threat]]'', Gorm was seen sending out either a {{p|Mandibuzz}} or a {{p|Zweilous}} to combat the Trainers trying to free the captured Gym Leaders. It is unclear which Pokémon belonged to him. ==Trivia== * In Black and White, Gorm quotes lines from Chinese classical text: ** ''"Know your enemies, know yourself, and know you need not fear the result of a hundred battles..."'''''アスラ'''：敵を知り　己を知れば　百戦して　危うからず…… ({{game|Black and White|s}}, Japanese) refers to the quote 知彼知己，百戰不殆 in ''{{wp|The Art of War}}'', an ancient military treatise attributed to general and strategist {{wp|Sun Tzu}}. ** ''"If you make a mistake and do not correct it, that is a second mistake."'''''アスラ'''：過ちて　改めざる　是を　過ちと　いう ({{game|Black and White|s}}, Japanese) refers to the quote 過而不改，是謂過矣 in the ''{{wp|Analects}}'', an ancient philosophical text of sayings attributed to {{wp|Confucius}}. ** ''"A single fallen leaf signals the start of autumn."'''''アスラ'''：一葉　落ちて　天下の秋を知る ({{game|Black and White|s}}, Japanese) refers to the quote 見一葉落，而知歲之將暮 in the ''{{wp|Huainanzi}}'', an ancient philosophical text of essays compiled from debates in the court of the {{wp|Huainan Kingdom}}. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{blue color}}; border:3px solid #{{blue color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{blue color light}}; color:#FFFFFF" | Language ! style="background:#{{blue color light}}; color:#FFFFFF" | Name ! style="background:#{{blue color light}}; color:#FFFFFF" | Origin |- | Japanese | アスラ ''Azula'' | From ''azul'' (Spanish for "blue")[https://twitter.com/matsumiyan/status/284308082543173632 Tweet by Toshinobu Matsumiya マツミや (@matsumiyan).
